purpose: Illustrative certified semantic catalog; deliberately limited compiler.

net_order_value.description: Line quantity times unit price minus line discount

shipping_fees.description: Shipment-level shipping fees; do not sum after order-line join

notes: A certifying steward must validate formulas for actual production usage.
Do not interpret all structurally connected open-order value as expected financial loss.
No free-form SQL is accepted from users.
plan_contract documents what forgeworks.semantics.execute_plan accepts; it adds no metric, dimension or filter.

plan_contract.group_by: at most one dimension, shared by every requested metric
plan_contract.composition: each metric is evaluated at its own base grain, then results are merged on the shared dimension

changelog.change: Four certified metrics, two dimensions, two order statuses.
Documented the query-plan contract and the certified filter of open_order_value. No metric, dimension, filter or formula changed; every certified total is unchanged.
